title: Incident: late and broken data
objectives: Measure which loads missed their deadline, and by how much
Find rows a retried load added twice

exercises.prompt: load_log has each batch's arrival and its deadline (sla_at). Return the batches that arrived after their deadline: batch_id and minutes_late, in batch_id order.
hints: The starter finds the late batches but not by how much.
date_diff('minute', sla_at, arrived_at) gives the minutes between them. In T-SQL it's DATEDIFF(minute, sla_at, arrived_at).

exercises.prompt: Batch B3 was retried and both copies loaded, so sales B3 and B3-retry hold the same sales. Return the corrected revenue for each sold_on: sold_on and revenue, counting each sale_id once, in sold_on order.
hints: The starter adds up every row, so sales 5 and 6 count twice.
Take each sale once first: SELECT DISTINCT sale_id, sold_on, amount FROM sales, then add up by sold_on.
